units.rawText: Sometimes, I find myself thinking that if you'd been in charge of me, a lot more people would have survived instead of dying. All you need to do is make the call; just leave the professional work to me!

units.rawText: And yes, I know it's risky, but... Well, SOMEONE has to do it. If there's a little ray of hope left, if there's one more person left to save, then I'll head straight for the frontlines to do my best there. This strange sense of righteousness has been with me from the beginning.

units.rawText: Never mind where it came from, isn't it natural to cherish life?

units.rawText: Even if it's just a base personality setting because I'm a rescue worker, doesn't that mean it's always been a part of me and something I can be proud of?
